artifact_reconciliation.rule: For a latest-successful metadata row whose selected CSV path is missing, use a CSV only when the same condition folder contains exactly one CSV artifact.

interpretation.scope: This article-results bundle intentionally includes direct-generation runs only.
interpretation.stability: One run per condition prevents within-condition stability estimation.
interpretation.human_review: No human-evaluation data are included in this replication package.
interpretation.statistics: All article summaries are descriptive; no hypothesis tests are computed.
